title: Outdoor air required.
officialText:
The minimum outdoor airflow rate shall be determined in accordance with Section 403.3. Ventilation
supply systems shall be designed to deliver the required rate of outdoor airflow to the breathing zone within each occupiable space.
Exception: Where a registered design professional demonstrates that an engineered ventilation system design will prevent the
maximum concentration of contaminants from exceeding that obtainable by the rate of outdoor air ventilation determined in
accordance with Section 403.3, the minimum required rate of outdoor air shall be reduced in accordance with such engineered
system design.
